defects.description: The heading "RoleAgentFactory" is not translated to the required Russian term for "Role Agent" (Ролевой агент) and the factory concept.
The heading "Session manifest traceability" is not translated; the term "Session" should be rendered as "Сессия".
The code token "role_agent_config" was altered to "Роль_agent_config", breaking byte‑identical requirement.
